text:
maya: Quick follow-up from yesterday's RFC review — I want to propose a small, explicit 'mode interface' contract that we can ship to avoid fuzzy ad-hoc logic between hosted/dedicated/private routing.

own: Curious — what's the minimum surface you think we need?

maya: At minimum: routing hint, creds source, telemetry tags, and failover policy. Also a short handshake so control plane can validate compatibility before sending traffic.

sophia: Can we make the handshake opt-in for legacy adapters? Not all runtimes can do a synchronous validation.

maya: Yes — default to async probe with a TTL for capability assertion. Handshake should be optional but recorded.

rafa: Example usage: hosted requests get routed with `mode=hosted;cred=rcs-token;telemetry=tenant:prod` while private gets `mode=private;cred=customer-kms;telemetry=tenant:prod,env:vpc` — can we encode that as a small proto?

own: Paste a tiny proto here and we can iterate. Something landable.

maya: Sure — rough sketch: 
```proto
message ModeBinding {
  enum Mode { HOSTED = 0; DEDICATED = 1; PRIVATE = 2; }
  Mode mode = 1;
  string cred_source = 2; // short id for the credential provider
  map<string,string> telemetry = 3; // tenant/env/route hints
  oneof failover {
    string fallback_model = 4;
    bool circuit_break = 5;
  }
  bool require_handshake = 6;
}
```

sophia: Looks fine. Can we fold `telemetry` into a typed list instead of map? maps are fine for now.

rafa: Concern: private on-prem runtimes won't accept external telemetry keys crossing boundary. We should support a sanitize/filter policy.

maya: Agreed — add `telemetry_policy` enum: PASS_THROUGH, SANITIZE, DROP. Default SANITIZE for private.

own: Operational question — who owns the validation error path? If handshake fails, does request fall back to hosted or fail fast?

maya: Propose configurable policy per-tenant: FALLBACK_TO_HOSTED, QUEUE_AND_RETRY, FAIL_FAST. Default for important tenants: FALLBACK_TO_HOSTED with rate cap.

rafa: Sounds okay. Also: metrics — we need per-mode counters for handshake success/fail, fallback rate, and sanitize drops. Put them on control plane telemetry.

sophia: Ops-side: add a small agent-level flag so runtime can run in `compat-mode` that ignores unknown fields. That will reduce rollout friction.

maya: Good call. Also add a version field for ModeBinding so we can evolve shape.

own: Implementation plan: 1) land proto + basic serializer in runtime common; 2) add control-plane validator that enforces cred_source whitelists; 3) runtime agent reads `ModeBinding` at connection time and emits metrics.

rafa: Timeline? We can do proto + validator in 2 weeks, runtime change 3-4 weeks.

maya: I'll open an RFC follow-up PR with the proto and a migration guide. Will ping infra for the validator work.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist: please attach backwards-compat tests, a feature flag `mode_binding_v1`, and a small playbook for oncall describing fallback activation.

maya: Thanks — I'll include tests and a playbook stub. Anyone want to take ownership of the runtime agent change?

sophia: I can take runtime agent, pairing with owen for the serializer bits.

own: happy to pair.

maya: Great — I'll draft the PR and link it here. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
